fb_delete_desc: They leave the volume: there is no trash.
fv_empty_volume: Empty volume: import your first files.
fv_empty_hint_touch: Tap Import to encrypt files and photos here.
fv_empty_hint: Drag files here, or use Import.
ql_video_failed: This video cannot play here. Use “Open with…”.
ql_audio_failed: This audio cannot play here. Use “Open with…”.
ep_hint_initial: The letter “{letter}” of the name, engraved.
ep_hint_icon: An engraved symbol of your choice.
ep_hint_image: Your own picture, engraved in lines in the volume’s ink.
ep_image_hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP: it becomes a 256×256 square of at most 64 KB.
look_visible_hint: Colour and symbol show even while the volume is locked.
look_encrypted_hint: While locked the volume looks neutral.
sm_need: It needs a “{level}” password or better: a phrase of 4-5 words is fine.
det_emblem_hidden: Hidden while locked: only a rosette shows.
det_emblem_visible: It shows while locked too, in the list and on unlock.
det_keys_hint: Each key opens the volume on its own, up to 8.
det_only_key: It is the only key: add another one before removing it.
det_autolock_hint: It locks by itself after the chosen idle time, and at once if its drive is disconnected.
det_autolock_never_hint: It does not lock when idle; it still locks if its drive is disconnected.
det_scope_hint: Disconnecting the drive always locks only this volume.
det_backends_hint: Shows the volume as a disk in the computer’s file manager.
det_remove_desc: “{name}” will no longer open the volume.
det_remove_in_use: It is the key you opened it with now.
duress_what: Entered on unlock, it destroys this file’s keys and answers like a wrong password. From then on no password opens it.
duress_limit: Limit: copies of the file made earlier (backups, other drives) are not affected.
duress_confirm: I understand: entering it destroys this volume, for good.
duress_remove_desc: “{name}” will no longer destroy the volume when entered.
err_exists: Something with this name already exists.
err_autostart_failed: The system’s startup entry could not be written: nothing was changed.
err_last_slot: It is the only key: it cannot be removed.
err_mount_unavailable: This computer cannot mount it as a drive.
err_mount_failed: The system refused to mount it.
err_busy: Files on the drive are still open.
err_not_a_vault: This file is not a NiceVault volume.
err_invalid_slot: This key is not a password.
err_duress_conflict: It must differ from every other password of the volume.
err_rolled_back: This volume's header was replaced with an older copy, which could bring back old passwords: it was not opened. Use the latest copy of the file.
err_unsafe_type: Programs and scripts are not opened from a volume: export the file first.
err_too_many_tags: There are already too many tags (at most 1000).
err_image_complex: Image too complex: try another one.
unlock_drive_gone: Drive disconnected: plug it back in to unlock this volume.
lock_sleep: Locked when the computer went to sleep
lock_screen: Locked when the screen was locked
toast_appearance_tampered: {name}: its look shown while locked had been altered. It has been restored.
toast_host_copy: The opened copy sits on this computer's disk while the volume is open: it is wiped at lock, but a crash or an app holding it open can leave it behind. On a computer that isn't yours, prefer Export.
rollback_title: This is an older copy of the volume
rollback_body: {name} is behind where this computer last saw it: the file was replaced by an earlier copy of itself (a restored backup, a cloud version, or someone undoing changes). Whatever was written after that copy is not here.
rollback_hint: If it wasn’t you, don’t write to it: lock the volume and look for the newest copy.
toast_damaged_demo: Cannot read the volume: the file is damaged.
mount_fuse_missing: fusermount3 or /dev/fuse is missing on this computer.
mount_nfs_admin: On this Mac, NFS mounting needs administrator rights.
mount_winfsp_missing: WinFsp (free) is needed: install it, then reopen NiceVault.
err_unsupported_version: Saved by a newer version of NiceVault: use that version to change it. Nothing was changed.
pm_empty_hint: Create one or import them from Bitwarden, KeePass or a CSV.
pm_none_selected: Pick an entry from the list.
pm_copied: {field} copied. The clipboard clears in {n} s.
pm_delete_desc: The entry and its history leave the volume.
pm_shortcuts: Ctrl+C password · Ctrl+B username · Ctrl+T 2FA · Ctrl+Shift+M move · Ctrl+F search

match.countPlural=one: {n} entry taken out of its folder.
match.countPlural=*: {n} entries taken out of their folders.

pm_folder_search: Search, or type a new folder
pm_folder_rename_hint: Subfolders follow. A name that already exists merges the two folders.
pm_folder_delete_desc: Entries are not deleted: they move, with the subfolders, into the parent folder.
pm_folder_deleted: Folder deleted. Its entries are in the parent folder.
pm_selection_hint: Ctrl+click or Shift+click to pick more. Drag them onto a folder to move them.
pm_repair_hint: Entries imported before this version may have raw fields (AUTOFILLURLS, CREATETIME…): they become the entry’s websites and dates.
pm_f_totp_hint: Paste the QR text (otpauth://) or the secret key.
pm_f_totp_keep: The saved 2FA code stays. Type a new one to replace it.
pm_f_totp_removed: 2FA will be removed when you save.
imp_note: The file stays where it is: NiceVault reads the entries and encrypts them inside the volume. Delete the plain-text export yourself when you are done.
welcome_sub_empty: No volumes here yet: making one takes a second.
welcome_sub: They stay encrypted until you unlock them.
welcome_hint: Connect a drive: the volumes at its top level appear here.
create_name_hint: It shows in the list of volumes.
create_exists: A volume with this name already exists here.
create_warn: If you forget it, nobody can recover the data: not even us.
create_done_hint: It is already open: add a second password in Details.
mount_off: Off. The files stay in here.
set_kicker: Of this computer, not of a volume
set_kicker_phone: Of this phone, not of a volume
set_lang_forced: This window was opened with ?lang={lang}: the choice applies from the next start.
set_app_hint: Welcome, Settings, New volume and the unlock page of volumes with an encrypted look. Inside a volume, its own look applies.
set_start_minimized_hint: At login NiceVault starts hidden, with its icon in the notification area.
set_startup_portable: From a stick NiceVault does not register itself on the computer, so it cannot start at login.
set_startup_hint: How NiceVault starts and what happens when you close its window.
set_close_to_tray: Stay in the tray when the window is closed
set_close_to_tray_hint: Closing the window hides it: NiceVault keeps running with its icon in the notification area, and open volumes stay open until auto-lock closes them. Quit in the icon’s menu locks them all and closes the app. If the desktop shows no notification icons, closing the window quits.
set_sounds_hint: Small, sober sounds for unlock, lock, copy, delete and finished operations. Low volume; never while the window is hidden.
set_new_like_app_hint: New volumes take the app’s theme and ink.
set_new_volumes_hint: They apply only to volumes you create.
set_drives_hint: Open volumes the computer sees as disks.
set_drives_none: No volume is mounted as a drive.
set_updates_hint: With “Check at start-up” NiceVault looks for a new version at most once a day; otherwise only when you ask here. Updates are signed: one with a wrong signature is not installed.
set_storage_portable: These settings last only while the app is open: nothing is written on the drive or the computer.
set_licences_hint: Third-party components, fonts and word lists NiceVault uses.
set_site_icons_hint: To show an entry’s icon, NiceVault asks its website directly (HTTPS, at most once a week): the site sees a request from your IP address. Icons are kept inside the volume.
upd_saved: The app can’t be replaced here: the new version was saved at this path. Close NiceVault and put it in place of the old one.
upd_check_on_start_portable: From a stick, this choice lasts until the app closes.
err_update_network: The update server can’t be reached.
err_update_signature: The update’s signature is not valid: it was not installed.
err_update_invalid: The offered update is not valid: it was not installed.
err_update_package: The update package is damaged or not for this app: it was not installed.
err_update_install: Update not installed: the app is unchanged.
err_update_restart: Restart failed: open NiceVault again by hand.
drive_gone: The drive “{name}” was disconnected: the location changed.
props_sha_hint: Fingerprint of the content: equal only if the bytes are identical.
props_unknown_hint: “—”: not recorded (files added before NiceVault kept it).
ep_frame_hint: The frame round the emblem, on the document and on the cover.
imp_note_after: You can delete the plain export now.
det_rotate_line: Encrypts the whole volume again with a new key: old copies of its header no longer open it.
rot_what: The whole volume is encrypted again with a new key. Old copies of its header (backups, copied files) won’t open anything written from now on.
rot_space: Needs free space as large as the volume: {need} ({free} free).
rot_space_unknown: Needs free space as large as the volume: {need}.
rot_keeps: Only the password you enter stays: every other key, the self-destruct one too, is removed.
rot_no_space: There isn’t enough free space on the drive.
rot_running: Writing the volume again with the new key…
rot_running_hint: Don’t quit the app or unplug the drive.
dev_entry_hint: Prepares a USB stick or external disk: NiceVault for Windows, macOS and Linux, and a partition for volumes.
dev_only_external: Only external or removable drives are listed.
dev_empty: Plug in a USB stick or external disk.
dev_complete_hint: Creating it stopped midway: Complete copies the programs again, without erasing anything.
dev_fs_hint: The volumes' partition: choose where it must be readable.
dev_table_gpt_hint: GPT: named partitions; needed over 2 TB.
dev_gpt_required: This drive is over 2 TB: GPT is used.
dev_sources_hint: For Windows, macOS and Linux, signed, from {host}: the signature is checked. Offline, this computer's copy is used.
dev_sources_local: Only the copies on this computer.
dev_vol_mode_whole_d: A volume as large as VaultData ({size}), preallocated: it does not grow and does not show how full it is.
dev_vol_mode_piece_d: A volume of the size you choose; the rest of VaultData stays free for other files.
dev_vol_fixed_hint_on: The space is reserved now; the file never changes size.
dev_vol_fixed_hint: The volume grows as you fill it.
dev_vol_size_bad: Choose a size between 1 GB and {max}.
dev_erase_b: will be erased. This cannot be undone.
dev_permission_note: Your system will ask for permission only to format.
dev_cancel_late: It can no longer be cancelled now.
dev_done_hint: On any computer open the NiceVault partition and start the program for that system (README.txt says which).
dev_missing: The programs for {list} are missing: connect to the internet and press Download now.
dev_fetch_missing_done: Programs added: the device is complete.
dev_refused_internal: It is not an external or removable drive.
dev_refused_hosts_app: The system or NiceVault runs from this drive.
dev_refused_open_volume: An open volume is on this drive: lock it first.
dev_busy_hint: One more moment: it's working, nothing else to do.
dev_busy_slow: This is taking longer than usual. You can cancel and try again: the drive has not been touched.
dev_auth_body: To format, the system asks for the administrator password in a window of its own. If you can't see it, it may be behind NiceVault.
dev_auth_ahead: After “Erase and create” the system will open a window of its own for the administrator password.
dev_volumes_body: {list}: they will be erased for good, with everything in them. If you have no copy elsewhere, stop here.
dev_volumes_ack: I understand: these volumes will be erased for good
dev_volumes_need_ack: To erase, also tick the box about the NiceVault volumes above.
dev_render_failed: This step could not be shown.
err_device_not_found: The drive is no longer connected.
err_device_refused: This drive cannot become a NiceVault device.
err_device_changed: The drive changed since you chose it: choose it again.
err_device_busy: A file on the drive is still open: close it and try again.
err_device_gone: The drive was unplugged. Plug it back in and use Complete.
err_elevation_denied: Permission was not granted: the drive was not touched.
err_elevation_unavailable: The system cannot ask for permission (udisks2 with a polkit agent is needed).
err_fs_unsupported: This system cannot create the chosen file system.
err_partition_failed: The system could not create the partitions.
err_client_missing: The programs to copy are missing.
err_device_download: The programs could not be downloaded: check the connection and try again.
err_signature_invalid: A program's signature is not valid: it was not copied.
err_confirmation_mismatch: The name typed does not match the drive.
err_no_space: There is not enough space for a volume of this size.
err_volume_full: The fixed-size volume is too full for the new format: extend it (Extend / Shrink) and try again.
err_invalid_size: The volume does not fit in VaultData.
sr_none_hint: Try fewer words, or loosen the filters.
flt_no_tags: No tags in this volume yet.
flt_empty_hint: Remove a filter to see more.
tag_none_yet: No tags yet: type one above.
tag_err_exists: A tag with this name already exists.
fmt_single: Single file: the change journal lives inside the volume, nothing next to it.
fmt_old: Previous format: while it is open, a -journal file sits next to the volume.
fmt_fixed: Fixed-size volume almost full: the single-file format needs a few MB free inside it. Extend it (Extend / Shrink) and try again.
fmt_warn: After the upgrade, NiceVault versions older than this one can no longer open the volume. It takes a moment and is safe even if interrupted.
fmt_done: Format upgraded: “{name}” is now a single file.
rsz_growable: This volume grows by itself: its file follows what it holds, there is no size to change.
rsz_slider: Size from the minimum to the maximum
rsz_plan_same: The volume already has this size.
rsz_plan_grow: The file grows by {delta}: {delta} must be free on the drive ({free} available). It is quick.
rsz_plan_shrink: The file gets {delta} shorter. The data stays where it is: no free space on the drive is needed.
rsz_plan_compact: Below {inplace} the data is compacted into a new copy of {size}, which then replaces the volume: {size} must be free on the drive ({free} available). It may take a few minutes.
rsz_plan_too_small: Too small: the volume's data needs at least {min}.
rsz_plan_too_large: Too large: the drive has room for up to {max}.
rsz_plan_no_space_compact: Below {inplace} the data has to be compacted into a new copy, which needs {size} free on the drive (there are {free}). Without free space you can shrink down to {inplace}.
rsz_wait_note: Do not unplug the drive. If it is interrupted, the volume opens with the old size or the new one: no data is lost.
rsz_failed: The size could not be changed.
rsz_failed_safe: The volume and its data are as before.
rsz_err_too_small: The volume's data does not fit this size.
rsz_err_no_space: There is not enough free space on the drive.
rsz_err_out_of_range: This size is not allowed (4 MB to 16 TB).
vw_info_hint: Here is what is known about the file, and its first bytes. To open it, use Export, or an external app while the volume is mounted as a drive.
vw_too_big_hint: This file is {size}; previews go up to {cap}. Export it, or open it in an external app from the mounted drive.
vw_unsupported_title: This format can't be read here
vw_unsupported_hint: The system viewer can't show this format. Export it, or open it in an external app from the mounted drive.
vw_error_hint: The content looks damaged or uses an unsupported variant. The file in the volume was not touched.
vw_csv_truncated: Showing the first {n} rows of this part.
vw_media_keys: J / L: back / forward 10 s · K: play / pause
vw_md_diagram_error: This diagram cannot be drawn: here is its text.
vw_office_readonly: Read-only · the text, not the layout
vw_office_truncated: The document is long: only its first part is shown.
vw_archive_opaque: {what} archive: its contents can't be listed without unpacking all of it. Export it to open it.
err_not_mounted: The volume isn't mounted as a drive: mount it to open files in an external app.
err_bad_link: Only web and e-mail links can be opened.
err_not_media: Only audio and video files are played.
stk_outdated: Some programs on the stick are older than this app, or missing.
stk_current: Up to date: the same as this app, or newer.
stk_not_mounted: The stick's NiceVault partition is not mounted: mount it to see and update the programs.
stk_incomplete: The stick is not complete: finish it with Create device › Complete.
stk_update: Update the programs on the stick
stk_safe_note: Only the NiceVault partition changes: your volumes and VaultData are not touched.
stk_runs_here: NiceVault runs from this stick: its program is the one in use.
stk_r_updated_tight: updated (in place of the old one)
stk_r_rewrite: to be rewritten: press Update again
stk_r_in_use: in use: NiceVault runs from here, update it from another computer
stk_space_tight: Tight space: the programs will be replaced one at a time.
stk_space_how: The old program is removed before the new one is written. If something goes wrong, press Update again.
stk_space_nofit: {os}: not enough room even in place of the current copy ({need} needed); it stays as it is.
stk_done_partial: The available ones are updated; the others when you are online.
stk_failed_safe: The programs that were there are still in place.
err_stick_not_mounted: The stick's NiceVault partition is not mounted.
err_stick_not_device: This drive is not a complete NiceVault device.
err_stick_full: There is not enough room on the stick's NiceVault partition.
pick_reason_offline: No network: it must be downloaded
pick_reason_expired: No longer available: pick it again
err_photos_failed: None of the photos could be imported.
err_expired: The picked photos are no longer available: pick them again.
mount_winfsp_unsupported: This WinFsp is too old: WinFsp {version} or newer is needed.
mount_winfsp_load_failed: WinFsp is installed but does not start: reinstall it, then reopen NiceVault.
mount_nfs_missing: This Mac lacks the system NFS client (/sbin/mount_nfs) that the drive needs.
mount_nfs_no_home: There is no home folder for this user, so nowhere to put the drive.
gallery_denied: NiceVault may not save to the gallery: allow it in Settings › NiceVault › Photos.
gallery_failed: Could not save to the gallery.
gallery_ask_title: Save photos and videos to the gallery?
gallery_ask_desc: When you export photos and videos they can go to the phone's gallery instead of Files. Other files always go to Files. You can change this in Settings.
set_gallery: Save photos and videos to the gallery
set_gallery_hint: Export puts photos and videos in the phone's gallery; other files go to Files. Once there they are outside the volume: unencrypted.
err_no_room_to_delete: There is not enough room to finish deleting. If the volume is fixed-size, extend it (Details › Extend / Shrink); otherwise free some space on the drive. What was already deleted stays deleted.
space_body_fixed: Not enough space: {need} needed, {free} free. Extend the volume to import these files.
space_body_growable: Not enough space: {need} needed, {free} free on the drive. Free up space on the drive and try again.
brw_hint: The NiceVault extension for Chrome, Edge, Brave and Firefox fills user names, passwords and 2FA codes from the unlocked volumes. It talks only to this app on this computer, never over the network.
brw_link_hint: Registers NiceVault with this user's browsers (a small file per browser, which works only with the NiceVault extension).
brw_reg_failed: The browsers could not be registered: {error}
brw_portable: Browsers do not connect to the copy on a stick: NiceVault must be installed on this computer.
brw_sandboxed: These browsers are sandboxed (Flatpak/Snap) and cannot connect to NiceVault: {list}.
brw_paired_none: No browser connected. Press Connect in the extension and confirm the code here.
brw_default_hint: The browser suggests unlocking this volume when it does not know yet where a site's passwords are.
brw_accesses_none: No access from a browser since NiceVault started.
brw_rule: A volume's password is typed only in a NiceVault window, never in the browser.
brw_pair_body: The code in the browser must be:
brw_pair_hint: If you did not ask to connect a browser, or the code is different, refuse.
brw_unlock_hint: The browser asks for this volume's passwords. Type the password here, not in the web page.
det_browser_enabled_hint: The NiceVault extension may offer and fill this volume's logins while it is unlocked.
